fields.statement: At e2f56e49a re-ran the Checks: block: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestWatchdogPollBehind (exit 0; TestWatchdogPollBehind and TestWatchdogPollBehindSteps PASS), go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestWatchdogPollBehind|Daemon|Poll' (exit 0, 259s), rhiza ship generate (exit 0), rhiza render (exit 0, tree unchanged); gofmt -l and go vet ./internal/api clean. Diff read: pollSteps times registry load, open, and per project reap/settings/machine/housekeeping/usage/demand/starts/notify/watchdog/events/model steps; projects poll sequentially so no race. TestWatchdogPollBehindSteps uses a fake clock advanced inside named steps and asserts the exact line keeps the 'watchdog: poll took ... poll interval' prefix and ends '; slowest: rhiza watchdog 5m58s, rhiza demand 21s, other events 3s' (slowest first, project and rounded time), that the recorded watchdog action carries it, and that a poll within the limit logs nothing. Only the four named Go files plus the builder's actor record and rendered files changed; no TODOs or stubs.
